subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a part of the hardware of a computer?
solution:
The correct answer is **Microsoft Office**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Microsoft Office** is a software suite, not hardware.
 
• Hardware components are physical parts of a computer.
 
• Examples of hardware include the monitor, keyboard, and CPU.
 
• Software like Microsoft Office is used to perform tasks on a computer.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Option 2
 A **Monitor** is an output device that displays information visually.
 
 

 Option 3
 A **Keyboard** is an input device used to enter data into a computer.
 
 

 Option 4
 The **CPU** (Central Processing Unit) is the primary component of a computer that performs most of the processing.
